SELECT /*selectMasterMpDsOrderManageList*/ Y.BUYER_ITEM_NO, -- 1 Y.DESCRIPTION, -- 2 Y.ADD_NAME, -- 3 Y.ADD_DATE, -- 4 Y.DS_QTY, -- 5 Y.PO_DATE, -- 6 Y.GR_DATE, -- 7 Y.REMARK, -- 8 DECODE(Y.REMARK,'','0','1') AS REMARK_IMG, Y.STATUS, -- 9 Y.DS_DATE, -- 10 Y.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, -- 11 DECODE(Y.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT,'','0','1') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT_IMG, Y.UNIT_MEASURE, -- 12 Y.RD_DATE, -- 13 Y.GR_QTY, -- 14 Y.REF_NO, -- 15 DECODE(Y.REF_NO,'','0','1') AS REF_NO_IMG, Y.BUYER, -- 16 Y.SEQ, -- 17 Y.DS_SEQ, -- 18 DECODE(TRIM(Y.PACKAGE_STATUS), '', 'Mapping' ,Y.PACKAGE_STATUS) AS PACKAGE_STATUS, -- 19 Y.BUYER_NAME, -- 20 Y.AGENT_NAME, Y.HIS_COUNT, -- 21 DECODE(Y.HIS_COUNT,'0','0','1') AS HIS_COUNT_IMG, Y.IV_QTY, -- 22
CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ('PR','PO','DS','IV','GR') THEN '3' ELSE '2' END STATUS_PR, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'PO','DS','IV','GR') THEN '3' ELSE '2' END STATUS_PO, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'DS','IV','GR') THEN '3' ELSE '2' END STATUS_DS, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'IV','GR') THEN '3' ELSE '2' END STATUS_IV, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'GR') THEN (CASE WHEN Y.DS_QTY > Y.GR_QTY THEN '4' ELSE '3' END ) ELSE '2' END STATUS_GR
CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ('PR','PO','DS','IV','GR') THEN '완료' ELSE '미완료' END STATUS_PR, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'PO','DS','IV','GR') THEN '완료' ELSE '미완료' END STATUS_PO, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'DS','IV','GR') THEN '완료' ELSE '미완료' END STATUS_DS, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'IV','GR') THEN '완료' ELSE '미완료' END STATUS_IV, CASE WHEN Y.STATUS IN ( 'GR') THEN (CASE WHEN Y.DS_QTY > Y.GR_QTY THEN '부분완료' ELSE '완료' END ) ELSE '미완료' END STATUS_GR
FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM NUM , X.BUYER_ITEM_NO, X.DESCRIPTION, X.ADD_NAME, X.ADD_DATE, X.DS_QTY, X.PO_DATE, X.GR_DATE, X.REMARK, X.DS_DATE, X.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, X.UNIT_MEASURE, X.RD_DATE, X.GR_QTY, X.REF_NO, X.BUYER, X.SEQ, X.DS_SEQ, X.PACKAGE_STATUS, X.BUYER_NAME, X.HIS_COUNT, X.IV_QTY, X.STATUS, X.AGENT_NAME FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DESCRIPTION, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_NAME, A.ADD_DATE AS ADD_DATE, B.DS_QTY AS DS_QTY, A.PO_DATE AS PO_DATE, B.GR_DATE AS GR_DATE, B.BTOA_REMARK AS REMARK, CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(B.DS_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS DS_DATE, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT, (SELECT UNIT_MEASURE FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS UNIT_MEASURE, B.RD_DATE AS RD_DATE, B.GR_QTY AS GR_QTY, A.REF_NO AS REF_NO, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.SEQ AS SEQ, B.DS_SEQ AS DS_SEQ, CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='GB' THEN '반려' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='FY' THEN '취소' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='NW' THEN '등록중' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='ED' THEN '완료' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS ^='ED' THEN '마케팅' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS ^='ED' THEN '문안' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS='ED' AND (C.ES_MK1_STATUS='N' OR C.ES_PD1_STATUS='N' AND C.ES_QA1_STATUS ='N')THEN '디자인' ELSE CASE WHEN C.RECV_FLAG='IG' AND C.MM_STATUS='ED' AND C.DD_STATUS='ED' AND C.EE_STATUS='ED' AND C.ES_MK1_STATUS='Y' AND C.ES_PD1_STATUS='Y' AND C.ES_QA1_STATUS='Y' THEN '최종확인' END END END END END END END END AS PACKAGE_STATUS,
(SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(HIS_SEQ) FROM DB_OFF_PO_HISTORY WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND SEQ = A.SEQ)AS HIS_COUNT,
NVL(A.IV_QTY,0) AS IV_QTY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME FROM DB_OFF_PO A, DB_OFF_IV B, DONGOPKG C
WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
WHERE A.BUYER IN ('KRDONG0110','KRDONG0107','KRDONG0128','KRDONG0732')
AND A.ADD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.PO_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND B.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND (SELECT DESCRIPTION_LOC FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) LIKE '%' || #{st_description} || '%'
AND (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.PURCHASER_ID) LIKE '%' || #{st_purchaser_name} || '%'
AND CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END = #{st_po_status}
AND CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0)=0 THEN 'PR' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NULL THEN 'PO' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NULL THEN 'DS' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NULL THEN 'IV' ELSE CASE WHEN A.PR_QTY ^=0 AND NVL(B.PO_QTY,0) ^=0 AND B.DS_QTY^=0 AND B.DS_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_DATE IS NOT NULL AND B.INV_USEr_ID IS NOT NULL AND B.GR_USER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'GR' END END END END END IN ('PR','PO','DS','IV')
AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER AND A.ADD_DATE=B.ADD_DATE AND A.SEQ=B.SEQ AND B.STATUS ^='D' AND B.CLOSE_FLAG||NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) ^='Y0' AND C.BYCA_COMORG_CODE(+)=A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND C.RD_DATE(+)=A.OPKG_RD_DATE AND C.OPKG_SEQ(+)=A.OPKG_SEQ AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+)=A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ) X ) Y
ORDER BY RD_DATE, PO_DATE DESC
